key.description: The resource's identity, when that is not its path. Say it when you move the file: the path the resource had. It never changes.

path.description: The resource's path, when the file is kept somewhere that does not give it one.

description.description: What the theme is for, in plain text.

canvas.description: The color behind everything: the page's background.

surface.description: The color of cards, panels and the body of a page.

sunken.description: The color of what is set into a surface, such as a well or a field's background.

line.description: The hairlines between things: dividers and the edges of a card.

ink-muted.description: The color of secondary text, such as a description under a heading.

action.description: The color of the main button, of links and of what is chosen.

action-ink.description: The color of text on the `action` color.

action-soft.description: A pale tint of `action`, for a background that points at something chosen.

attention.description: The color that asks to be noticed without being an error, such as a warning.

attention-soft.description: A pale tint of `attention`, for the background of a warning.

danger.description: The color of an error and of what cannot be undone.

danger-soft.description: A pale tint of `danger`, for the background of an error.

success.description: The color of what went well.

success-soft.description: A pale tint of `success`, for the background of a good result.

structure.description: The color that gives a page its frame, such as the track behind a progress bar.

raised.description: The color of what lies above the page, such as a menu or a dialog.

selected.description: The background of a row or an item that is chosen.

line-strong.description: A stronger line, where an edge must be seen, such as under a heading.

line-control.description: The edge of a control such as an input, which must be seen against what is around it.

ink-subtle.description: The color of the faintest text that is still read, such as a hint.

focus.description: The ring drawn around what the keyboard is on.

radius-control.description: How round the corners of a button or a field are, as a length.

radius-panel.description: How round the corners of a card or a panel are, as a length.

font.description: The typeface of text, as a list of fonts to try in order.

font-code.description: The typeface of code, as a list of fonts to try in order.

tokens.description: Values that replace the tenant's, by token name.
